caseName: Baltimore & Ohio Railroad v. Boston & Maine Railroad
caseNameFull: Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Co. v. Boston & Maine Railroad Maryland Port Authority v. Boston & Maine Railroad and Interstate Commerce Commission v. Boston & Maine Railroad
attorneys: Thomas E. Dewey on the motion for enlargement of time for oral argument.

opinions.text: Appeals from the United States District Court for the District of Massachusetts. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 370 U. S. 914.) The motion of John H. Colgren for leave to withdraw his appearance as counsel for appellees is granted. The motion for enlargement of time for oral argument is granted and 45 additional minutes are allotted to each side. Mr. Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
